tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Other Conditions as per Bid document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the Bidder is a manufacturer- must have manufactured, tested, supplied and delivered Similar type of Student Essential Kits/ School Kits at least 80% (1,04,000 Nos.) to any Government Dept/ Boards/ Local Bodies/ Government organizations/ Public Sector Undertakings in any one year of the Three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 as on bid submission date is mandatory

If the Bidder is an Authorized dealer- must have supplied satisfactorily at least 30% (39,000 Nos.) Similar type of Student Essential Kits/ School Kits to any Government / Urban Local Bodies/ Government organizations/ Public sector Undertakings in any one year of the three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 as on bid submission date is mandatory.

If the Bidder is a MSME Bidder- shall registered for Similar Products under Udyam Registration Portal and has supplied satisfactorily at least 40% (52,000 Nos.) of Similar type of Student Essential Kits/ School Kits to any Government / Urban Local Bodies/ Government organizations/ Public sector Undertakings in any one year of the last Two financial years 2024-25 & 2025-26 as on bid submission date is mandatory.
The Bidder should be Companies/Firms who are Original Equipment Manufacturers /Authorized dealers registered under the appropriate Act with their office exist in Karnataka.
